identity: request ordinal plus prompt_fnv64, within the externally owned native instance; not a cryptographic source/binary/request identity
scope: Linux/SYCL ordinary GEN, loaded native MTP, spec capacity 4, actual T 1..4, split off, suffix 0, no lookup/batch/peer/remote; layers 1..64, workers 1..128
service_thread: -1 is issuer/host participant; 0..workers-1 are persistent pool worker indices, not OS TIDs
equations: CPU group entry sum=job nt sum
route entries per completed layer=sum(actual T*k)
completion: Only joined close complete=1 is authoritative. coverage_complete or service_complete alone is insufficient. Final wait_commit success, observed terminal EOS/cap, normal DONE close, exact route/window/pool/source counter cross-checks and bounded output are all required; length must reach actual max_new.
failure_prefix: W/R/D/A/C are successful ver.run plus commit-return prefixes. Failed/absent final commit wait never qualifies physical commit completion or a complete close. Attempted/verified run prefixes are retained independently.
limitations: wall minus thread CPU is not pure wait
logical bytes are not measured DRAM/H2D traffic
per-thread service role totals are not joined per-format exclusive service times
existing pool wait_park/repark timing getters cover run(), not distinct native run_phase wait timing; zero deltas do not prove absent waits
aliases are a retained reference owner bin; current SYCL verifier forces pcie mode 0
missing receipt after kill/abort is absent evidence, never complete
